ListPreference.android:title: Certificate problems
ListPreference.android:summary: %s, when a site's security certificate is invalid.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Popups allowed
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Let sites open windows you did not tap for. You are asked each time.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: System downloader
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Download with Android's download manager. If off, downloads are handed to another app. Long press the downloads button to toggle.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Location requests
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Let sites ask for your location; you allow or deny each site.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Open links from other apps in the background
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: A link tapped in another app opens as a new tab while you stay in that app.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Keep screen on
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Keep the screen awake while the browser is in front. Fullscreen video always keeps it on.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Open YouTube links in the YouTube app
Alt + key shortcuts
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: With a hardware keyboard, Alt works like Ctrl: T new tab, W close tab, R reload, L address bar, F find.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Desktop site user agent
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Leave empty to derive one from the built-in browser engine.
